book.name: 1 Pita
book.title: Pitadi Bepaŋ’walaŋ metamdok pepa timeŋ youyemguk

content: Indetok nadinene fofoŋ tuluwaak

Nu talitimeŋ nohikdi notneye talitimeŋ uŋoŋ hatiiŋ hiditok mede hanimbit. Kilisto adi folofigita nadilune nu nagoŋ daunedi hinek kagut. Ala hatigene Jesu wougigitnit mintadakaleune u maaŋ kahilewaat. Nu wendoktiŋa mede indiŋ hanindidimewe nadineŋ.

Bepaŋ’walaŋ dompa bop yabudokodok hapmegiŋ hidi yadi kwanai-mede haniŋgiŋ doktiŋa moŋ, Bepaŋdi nadilak wendok tuwot welehikdi yabukahileeŋ yabudokoyaneeŋ. Tiŋa undugoŋ muneeŋ bomboŋ tubumintadok nadiŋa moŋ, welehik eŋ kwanaidi folooŋnit titiŋdok nadiŋa taneeŋ.
Be hidetok nadiune loloŋnit tubune moŋ, adi dompa yabudokooŋ Bepaŋ’walaŋ Mede Momooŋ u hidegoŋ takaliune habuŋa takaliyaneeŋ.
Ala kougoŋ hatigene dompa yabudoko wapum ne buŋa tuwahik dapmandapmaŋnit mokit kuluŋ tehindilendileŋnit mokohambaak.
Mekuyahi naŋgat kaipmuŋ, hiditok maaŋ indiŋ hanimbit. Bepaŋ’walaŋ Youkudipdi indiŋ yolak:

content.text: “Bepaŋ adi metam nehitok nadiune loloŋnit tiiŋ adi’walaŋ kasop diliteleyemilak. Iŋgoŋ metam noli nehitok nadiune fofoŋnit tiiŋ adi yehiulihiŋa siloŋ tobogoŋ tiyemilak.”

content: Unduŋ doktiŋa hidi yadi hidetok nadiune foune me talitimeŋhiyedok nadiyembune loune adi’walaŋ hebehik foloŋ kulemaŋgoŋ hatiyaneeŋ. Tiŋa undugoŋ, metam hogohogok, hidi hidetok nadiune fofoŋnit tubune kitubuloda taneeŋ.
Bepaŋ Saŋiniŋ Molom’walaŋ namanda foloŋ hidetok nadiune fofoŋ tubune hatineeŋ. Unduŋ tiŋa hatineeŋ ala adi’walaŋ nai mintawaak uŋaniŋ hanihehibelowaak.
Bepaŋ adi momooŋ hinek habudokolak doktiŋa nemek wendok be wendok nadibedi tiiŋ hogohogok u kwihililiweneeŋ Bepaŋdok mindapmayaneeŋ.
Saŋiniŋ Molom ne nihikasopnelak
Hidi hide nadididimeeŋ kikadoko taneeŋ. Memikhik wapum, Sadaŋ, adi fowa dabugoŋ
undiniŋ tiŋa i be i tiŋa kumuyewit yoŋa maŋiŋ ŋaŋ tiŋa tobodindiŋ
tihatilak.
Ale hidi nadisukiliti tiŋa fafaŋeŋ yali kelehapene tikutneeŋ. Nohiye kwetkwet noli gineŋ hatitawiiŋ adi folofigita hidi nadiiŋ undiniŋgoŋ nadiiŋ.

Biyagoŋ, hidi folofigita nai muniniŋ nadilune Bepaŋ siloŋ tobogoŋ Molomdi kasop tihamuŋa hehitubu-kilitiŋa hehitubu-damda tibaak. Adi Kilisto ne’walaŋ wougigit dapmandapmaŋnit mokit gineŋ noŋgoŋ yayatdok hanihehimaneguk.
Adi’walaŋ saŋiniŋŋiŋ u hakukdi haliwooŋ halaak fafaŋeniŋ. U biyagoŋ.
Mede yokiliti

Nu mede yoŋ adi Sailas nimbe youhamulak. Nu aditok nadiwene me notne folooŋ hinek tilak. Nu adi Bepaŋ’walaŋ siloŋ tobogoŋ diniŋ mede muniniŋ haniŋa indiŋ haniŋgiginelat: mede woŋ adi folooŋ hinek ale wendiniŋ maaneŋ fafaŋeeŋ yatneeŋ.
Metam Babilon kwetneŋ
hatiŋa Bepaŋdi Jesu’walaŋ kayoŋbop hidut mintadok yehidaneguk, adi welemomooŋ mede hiditok kamehamiiŋ. Eŋ mihine Mak adi maaŋ nadisuhamulak.
Hidi Bepaŋ’walaŋ Mede Momooŋdi kitubukiliti tiŋa menot momooŋ tiŋa hidebo kohokukut tiyaneeŋ. Tiŋa Kilisto dut hatiiŋ, hidi’walaŋkade kulemadi wanakaŋ tokidapmaaŋ hatuwaak.

footnotes.text: Gilik mede gineŋ adi laion dabugoŋ yolak.
“tobodindiŋ” adi kiyaneeŋ woŋambuŋat tilak wondok yolak.
Babilon kwetneŋ youkuk woŋ adi Lomahidok nadiŋa youkuk. Lomahi’walaŋ titiŋ u yadi Babilonhidi titiŋ tigiŋ nabugoŋ doktiŋa unduŋ youkuk.
